test_title: PYST 19: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

I find that students nowadays are not interested in ______ letters by hand.
solution:
The correct answer is **"writing."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Writing"** is the correct spelling of the word that fits in the blank.
 
• The word **"writing"** means to form letters or words on a surface with a pen or pencil. (लिखना (काग़ज़ पर क़लम या पेंसिल से))
 
 
• **Example:** ***Write**__ your name and address on the form.*
 
 
 
• The sentence suggests that students today are not interested in this activity of writing.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence:** *I find that students nowadays are not interested in __**writing**__ letters by hand.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Righting" **is a misspelling of the word and does not make sense in the context of the sentence.
 
• **"Rioting"** is a completely different word that means to take part in a violent disturbance of the peace. (उपद्रव मचाना, दंगा करना)
 
• **"Rating"** does not fit in the sentence and means to assign a value or classification to something. (किसी की लोकप्रियता, महत्व, श्रेष्‍ठता आदि की माप)
